name: Input / Textarea / Select
nameZh: 输入框 / 文本域 / 选择器
summary: The three text controls a form is mostly made of: a single-line input, a multi-line textarea and a native select. One stylesheet gives all three the same border, focus ring and disabled treatment, so a form reads as one form.
summaryZh: 表单里最常见的三种文本控件:单行输入框、多行文本域和原生下拉选择器。三者共用同一套描边、聚焦环和禁用态,所以一个表单看起来是一个整体。

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default control height. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

states.name: Focus
states.note: The border takes the brand colour and a soft ring is drawn around the control.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The shared layer paints a flat surface and the derived disabled text colour, so the value stays measurable.

states.name: Autosize
states.note: The textarea grows with the text in it. It is the browser's own field-sizing, so nothing in the library measures the text — the browser measures it and the field follows.

states.name: Filled
states.note: The control sits on a recessed surface and drops its border, so it reads as a well rather than as a box. The light run is the base class on its own.

states.name: No arrow
states.note: The select does not draw its arrow, and the text takes the room the arrow was in.

props.name: control
props.description: Which member of the family this is. Each one is its own class: um-input, um-textarea, um-select.
props.descriptionZh: 这一族里的哪一个。三者各有一个类:um-input、um-textarea、um-select。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint text for the input and the textarea. It takes the muted placeholder role, not the body colour.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框和文本域的提示文字。它用的是弱化的占位文字色,不是正文色。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the control inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让控件不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the value visible but stops it being edited. The library does not repaint a readonly control — it is not a state it measures.
props.descriptionZh: 值仍然可见,但不能编辑。库不会给只读控件单独配色 —— 这不是它测量过的状态。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The control's value, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the control holds whatever the reader typed; bind it and the control answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 控件的值,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就由读者输入的内容决定;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the control. The same modifier class reaches all three members of the family. The medium size is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 控件的尺寸。同一个修饰类管到这一族的所有成员。中号就是基础类本身。

props.name: autosize
props.description: Lets the textarea grow with the text in it. It is the browser's own field-sizing, so no line of script measures the text; the field follows what the reader typed. The run is written on the textarea — um-textarea um-input--autosize — because a single-line field has no text to grow with.
props.descriptionZh: 让文本域跟着里面的文字长高。它是浏览器自己的 field-sizing,所以没有一行脚本在量文字;字段跟着读者打的字走。这一跑要写在文本域上 —— um-textarea um-input--autosize —— 因为单行字段没有能长高的文字。

props.name: effect
props.description: The surface of the control. The light run is the base class on its own; the filled run adds um-input--filled, and the control sits on a recessed surface instead of in a frame.
props.descriptionZh: 控件的底面。浅色这一跑就是只写基础类;填充这一跑再加上 um-input--filled,控件坐在凹陷的面上,而不是坐在一个框里。

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of field the input is. It is the input's own type attribute, so the browser brings its own keyboard and its own validation with it. The textarea and the select are named by the `control` prop instead.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框是哪一种字段。它是 input 自己的 type 属性,所以浏览器会带上它自己的键盘和校验。文本域和选择器则由 `control` 这个属性来点名。

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the control belongs to. It is the input's own form attribute, so a control may live outside its form and still be submitted with it.
props.descriptionZh: 这个控件属于哪个表单。它是 input 自己的 form 属性,所以控件可以放在表单外面,仍然跟着那个表单一起提交。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Whether the select draws its arrow. The arrow is part of the control and is drawn by default, because a select without one does not say it opens a list; turning it off adds um-input--no-arrow, which takes the drawn arrow away and gives the text the whole width of the field.
props.descriptionZh: 选择器画不画自己的箭头。箭头是控件的一部分,默认就画着 —— 没有箭头的选择器不会说明自己会打开一份名单;关掉它会加上 um-input--no-arrow,把画出来的箭头拿走,把整条宽度让给文字。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content of the control. For the select it is the options; the input and the textarea hold their own value and take no content.
slots.descriptionZh: 控件里的内容。选择器放的是选项;输入框和文本域自己装着值,不装内容。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on the input and the textarea while the value is typed. It is the browser's own event — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 在输入框和文本域里输入内容时触发。这是浏览器自己的事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the value is committed: on blur for the input and the textarea, and when an option is picked for the select.
events.descriptionZh: 值被提交时触发:输入框和文本域在失焦时触发,选择器在选定选项时触发。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

events.name: focus
events.description: Fires when the control takes focus. The stylesheet reacts to :focus, so the brand border and the soft ring appear without a line of script.
events.descriptionZh: 控件获得焦点时触发。样式表响应 :focus,所以品牌色描边和柔和的聚焦环不靠一行脚本就能出现。

events.name: blur
events.description: Fires when the control loses focus.

a11y.notes: Every control keeps its native element, so the roles, the keyboard behaviour and the form submission all come from the platform: textbox for the input and the textarea, combobox for the select. The select's arrow is drawn with two CSS gradients instead of the native one, because the native arrow ignores the theme; the option list is still the platform's. A disabled control uses the real disabled attribute, so it is skipped by the tab order.
a11y.notesZh: 三种控件都保留原生元素,角色、键盘行为和表单提交都由平台提供:输入框和文本域是 textbox,选择器是 combobox。下拉箭头用两层 CSS 渐变画,而不是原生箭头 —— 原生箭头不跟主题走;选项列表仍然由平台提供。禁用的控件使用原生 disabled 属性,因此会被 Tab 顺序跳过。

examples.title: The three controls
examples.description: One class each: um-input for a single line, um-textarea for several, um-select for a choice. They are not variants of one another — they are three classes that share one stylesheet.
examples.descriptionZh: 各有一个类:单行是 um-input,多行是 um-textarea,选择是 um-select。它们不是彼此的变体,而是共用同一份样式表的三个类。
examples.markup:
<input class="um-input" type="text" placeholder="Your name" aria-label="Your name" />
<textarea class="um-textarea" rows="3" placeholder="Description" aria-label="Description"></textarea>
<select class="um-select" aria-label="Selection">
  <option>Choose an option</option>
  <option>Second</option>
  <option>Third</option>
</select>

examples.title: States
examples.description: A disabled control paints a flat surface and takes the derived disabled text colour rather than being dimmed with opacity, so what is written in it can still be measured.
examples.descriptionZh: 禁用的控件铺一层扁平底色,文字用派生出来的禁用色,而不是用 opacity 变淡 —— 这样里面写的内容依然可以被测量。
examples.markup:
<input class="um-input" type="text" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />
<textarea class="um-textarea" rows="3" placeholder="Disabled" disabled></textarea>
<select class="um-select" disabled>
  <option>Disabled</option>
</select>

notes: The three controls are three classes, not three variants: um-textarea and um-select carry no modifier, so the family is told apart by the class you write rather than by a modifier you add. The textarea is three control-heights tall and resizes vertically. The select drops the platform arrow and draws its own, because the platform arrow does not follow the theme.
notesZh: 三种控件是三个类,不是三个变体:um-textarea 和 um-select 都没有修饰类,所以这一族靠你写下的类区分,而不是靠再加一个修饰类。文本域默认三个控件高,竖向可拉伸。选择器去掉平台箭头、自己画一个,因为平台箭头不跟主题走。
